resolved.title: 关联数组
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Associative Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

While many programming languages support arrays with named indexes (text instead of numbers), called [b]associative arrays[/b],[b] [/b]JavaScript [b]does not[/b].
However, you still can use the named array syntax, which will produce an object.
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header]
[code format="js" codeId="700"]var person = []; //empty array
person["name"] = "John";
person["age"] = 46;
document.write(person["age"]);
[/code]Now, person is treated as an object, instead of being an array.
The named indexes "name" and "age" become properties of the person object.
[note]As the person array is treated as an object, the standard array methods and properties will produce incorrect results. For example, [b]person.length[/b] will return 0.[/note]

resolved.title: 关联数组
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Associative Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Remember that JavaScript [b]does not[/b] support arrays with named indexes.
In JavaScript, arrays always use numbered indexes.
It is better to use an [b]object [/b]when you want the index to be a [b]string[/b] (text).
Use an [b]array [/b]when you want the index to be a [b]number[/b].
[note]If you use a named index, JavaScript will redefine the array to a standard object.
[/note]

In JavaScript, arrays always use numbered indexes.

content.text:
请记住，JavaScript **不**支持带有命名索引的数组。
在 JavaScript 中，数组总是使用编号的索引。
当你希望索引是一个**字符串**（文本）时，最好使用一个**对象**。
当你希望索引是一个**数字**时，使用**数组**。
content.text_html:
Remember that JavaScript does not support arrays with named indexes. In JavaScript, arrays always use numbered indexes. It is better to use an **object **when you want the index to be a string (text). Use an **array **when you want the index to be a number.

请记住，JavaScript 不支持带有命名索引的数组。 在JavaScript中，数组总是使用编号的索引。 当你希望索引是一个字符串（文本）时，最好使用一个对象。 当你希望索引是一个数字时，使用数组**。

content.text: 如果你使用一个命名的索引，JavaScript 会将数组重新定义为一个标准对象。
content.text_html:
If you use a named index, JavaScript will redefine the array to a standard object.

如果你使用一个命名的索引，JavaScript会将数组重新定义为一个标准对象。
